title: Detailed bell
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- handle/loop at top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='13' r='6' fill='none' stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- top cap of bell -->
  <rect x='40' y='20' width='20' height='6' rx='3' fill='#C8960A'/>
  <!-- bell body -->
  <path d='M38 26 L62 26 C66 26 70 30 72 40 C74 50 78 60 82 68 L18 68 C22 60 26 50 28 40 C30 30 34 26 38 26 Z' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- bell body highlight -->
  <path d='M42 28 L58 28 C61 28 64 31 66 40 C68 49 71 57 74 64 L26 64 C29 57 32 49 34 40 C36 31 39 28 42 28 Z' fill='#FFE55C'/>
  <!-- decorative band upper -->
  <rect x='40' y='34' width='20' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#B8860B'/>
  <!-- decorative band lower -->
  <rect x='32' y='50' width='36' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#B8860B'/>
  <!-- vertical stripe details -->
  <rect x='49' y='37' width='2' height='13' rx='1' fill='#B8860B'/>
  <rect x='45' y='37' width='1.5' height='10' rx='0.75' fill='#E6B800'/>
  <rect x='53.5' y='37' width='1.5' height='10' rx='0.75' fill='#E6B800'/>
  <!-- lower inlay pattern -->
  <rect x='35' y='58' width='30' height='2' rx='1' fill='#D4A017'/>
  <!-- bell rim -->
  <rect x='18' y='66' width='64' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#B8860B'/>
  <rect x='20' y='67' width='60' height='2' rx='1' fill='#E6B800'/>
  <!-- clapper -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='76' r='7' fill='#D4A017'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='76' r='5' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='76' r='2.5' fill='#FFE55C'/>
  <!-- clapper highlight -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='74' r='1.5' fill='#FFF5B0'/>
  <!-- bell side highlights -->
  <path d='M30 40 C31 48 33 56 35 62' stroke='#FFF5B0' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M33 40 C34 47 36 54 38 59' stroke='#FFF5B0' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- handle highlight -->
  <path d='M46 11 C47 9 49 9 50 10' stroke='#FFF5B0' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
